decision.reason: Verified Reuters story has an immediate potential account/character transition and consent-rights workflow.

opportunities.idea_name: AI Companion Service Wind-Down Readiness Ledger
opportunities.core_job: Prepare a user-owned inventory and transition checklist when an AI companion service may cease operations
opportunities.target_customer: AI companion service users, digital rights advocates and small community administrators
opportunities.product_mechanism: Manually documented user-owned character/assets list, available platform export rights, official notices, critical deadlines, confirmation and human closure; never scrapes private chat data or bypasses access controls
opportunities.why_now: Reuters 13 October reported Character.AI Chapter 11, Disney $20m stalking-horse license offer, service continuing during sale but possible wind-down with no buyer.
opportunities.before_state: Users track uncertain platform continuity and rights in scattered emails/news.
opportunities.after_state: Dated readiness and source notice ledger distinguishing hypothetical shutdown from confirmed deadline.
opportunities.zero_cost_hypothesis: Client-side structured checklist; validation still required
